title: Carpet's random stuff
description: A mod that adds a new mob, structure and armor trims
body:
A mod made for a friend server that adds custom armor trims and more.

## Complete list:
# Custom trims:
  to get the trims you must
  1. search ominous vaults (amogus trim)
  2. search trail ruins suspicious gravel (cobble & ancient trim)
  3. search the custom structure's suspicious gravel (signal & connection trim) 
# Custom mob:
  a new mob that is highly agressive to players, iron golems, and normal pigs..?
  - water resistant IP68 (dies to water)
  - eyes lit up green when chill and red when agro
  - has two variants: iron and copper, copper has more hp and is stronger, also dropping a single emerald on death   
# Custom structure:
  a new 3-variant structure can now spawn that will spawn cyber pigs at night
# New item:
  a new item used as currency for the server, the coin!
  - can be crafted with four gold ingots surrounding a diamond
  - can be turned back to a diamond but the gold will be lost 
  - stacks to 99 to carry lots of it
